dedupe_keys.name: unofficial namma metro bengaluru gtfs feeds

description: This collection provides two unofficial GTFS representations of Namma Metro services in Bengaluru. Vonter combines timetable information published by BMRCL with OpenStreetMap stations, platforms, entrances and route geometry. One archive expands service into explicit trips; a second retains frequency-based scheduling. The documented pipeline transcribes timetable images, matches station geometry and generates stop times, shapes and fares. Spatial coverage is the represented Bengaluru metro network. Exact feed-validity dates were not checked, and scheduled times are derived service inputs, not live observations. The repository and both archive paths are public and free, with ODbL 1.0 stated in GitHub metadata. Intermediate stop times are approximations based on station spacing, average dwell time and average speed. The README expects differences of several minutes and warns that some short-loop services are missing or incompletely described by the original timetable. Simulation uses include comparing metro accessibility and preparing scheduled transit networks. It relates to data-openstreetmap, data-gtfs-specification and model-opentripplanner. Neither archive contents nor route-planner import were tested.
